attributes.name: scope
attributes.value: The residue treater and its recirculation, heating, cooling, vent and discharge systems as drawn in Fig 10 (p. 29) and described on pp. 27-32 and 38-40. Upstream (methomyl synthesis, flashers) and downstream (alternate fuel tank, flare) are battery limits.

attributes.name: tag_convention
attributes.value: The report names instrument types but no instrument or valve tag numbers for the residue treater, so every tag here is ASSIGNED by this project (ISA-5.1 letters, loop numbers 101-113) and marked assigned_tag: true. Equipment identifiers RT-1, E-1, E-2, E-3, P-1 are assigned the same way. Nothing here is the plant's own numbering.
